editorial.blurb: Manhatto is a stunning fusion of Japanese and Italian cuisines where impeccably fresh ingredients, thoughtful preparation, and genuinely attentive service create an experience worth the visit.
editorial.insiderTip: Arrive early or sit at the gorgeous wrap-around bar to avoid peak dinner noise and secure a seat quickly; Gerry's team takes excellent care of bar seating.

topDishes.note: Rich, creamy, and loaded with fresh uni, fish roe, and crab—a standout must-try
Solid and satisfying with an elote-like flavor profile
